name: Factory
source:
Work. Suffer. Repeat. Work. Suffer. Hmm... Hello ladies. Repeat.

A short experimental novel. Dystopia and melancholy. The life of an ordinary man and his drudgery at the factory. Ambiguous choices and four grey endings. 

[From [url=https://paper-sun.itch.io/factory]Itch.io[/url]]
